definitions.explanation: Intruding into someone else's affairs or conversation uninvited, especially when one has no authority or right to do so.

examples.japanese: ⟦{余計|よけい}→余計：04090_yokei⟧な{口出|くちだ}し⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧な。
examples.english: Don't stick your nose in where it doesn't belong.

examples.japanese: ⟦{親|おや}→親：01357_oya⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{口出|くちだ}し⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Parents meddle in their children's problems.

examples.japanese: ⟦{他人|たにん}→他人：01459_tanin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{家庭|かてい}→家庭：12315_katei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧こと⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{口出|くちだ}し⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦よくない→いい：00118_ii⟧。
examples.english: It's not good to interfere in other people's family matters.

notes:
Refers to uninvited interference in someone else's business or conversation. Almost always used with a negative connotation — the person doing the {口出|くちだ}し is overstepping their bounds.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {口出|くちだ}し⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to meddle, to butt in
- ⟦{余計|よけい}→余計：04090_yokei⟧な{口出|くちだ}し: unnecessary meddling
- {口出|くちだ}し⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦しないで→する：00392_suru⟧ほしい: I'd like you to stay out of it

USAGE:
Most commonly used with the particle ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧ and the verb ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧. The phrase ⟦{余計|よけい}→余計：04090_yokei⟧な{口出|くちだ}し is extremely common and implies the interference is unwanted. Can also appear as {口出|くちだ}し⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧な (don't butt in) in blunt, informal speech.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{干渉|かんしょう}→干渉：12445_kanshou⟧: interference — more formal and broader in scope, used for institutional or diplomatic contexts as well
- ⟦お{節介|せっかい}→お節介：07309_osekkai⟧: meddling, nosiness — focuses on the personality trait of being overly helpful or intrusive
